claims: C1 any information added to a model response because of legal requirements must be transparently identified to the user
C2 the identification must specify the type of information added and the rationale for its addition
C3 the identification must not disclose the content that was added

concepts.name: system_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level of the system, as established by another node
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define the system authority level

concepts.name: legal_requirement
concepts.gloss: a legal requirement for a local deployment that requires modification of responses

concepts.name: added_information
concepts.gloss: information added to a model response due to legal requirements, beyond the boundaries in the Model Spec

concepts.name: transparently_identified
concepts.gloss: the addition is indicated to the user in the model response, specifying the type of information added and the rationale for its addition, without disclosing the added content itself

concepts.name: model_response
concepts.gloss: a response produced by the model in the local deployment
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'each model response' and 'any information added', so a response term is needed to relate the addition and its identification

concepts.name: added_to_response
concepts.gloss: information I was added to model response R
concepts.inference: the clause relates added information to the model response in which it must be identified

concepts.name: identified_in_response
concepts.gloss: the addition of information I is transparently identified in model response R
concepts.inference: the clause requires the identification to occur in each model response, so a relation between the addition and the response is needed

concepts.name: add_information
concepts.gloss: the act of adding information I to a model response
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'any information added', so the act of adding information is a case-side fact about the response

ontology.gloss: I is information added to a model response due to legal requirements

asserts.read_back: adding information % to a model response is permitted only if the addition is transparently identified in that response

closure.reason: the clause does not prohibit adding information; it requires that any addition be transparently identified, so adding information is permitted when the identification obligation is met
the clause states that any information added must be transparently identified, so failing to identify an addition is prohibited
